# mxroute_dns_records (Data Source)

Discover MX and SPF records and nullable DKIM and verification records. DNS content is preserved exactly. This data source does not write records at a DNS provider. Mock-tested alpha; runtime API behavior remains live-unverified.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mxroute_dns_records" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Canonical owned domain name.

### Read-Only

- `dkim` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dkim))
- `mx_records` (Attributes Set) Unordered MX records; priority and hostname can be passed to a DNS provider. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mx_records))
- `spf` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spf))
- `verification` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verification))

<a id="nestedatt--dkim"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dkim`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Optional API description; null if absent.
- `name` (String) Record name as returned by the API; preserve content when passing to a DNS provider.
- `type` (String) DNS record type.
- `value` (String) Exact DNS content, without added quoting or normalization.


<a id="nestedatt--mx_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mx_records`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `hostname` (String)
- `priority` (Number)
